newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola board approves new stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola board approves new stock buyback.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co. said Thursday that its board of directors has approved a plan to buy back 10 percent of the company's outstanding shares under a new stock repurchase programme.
The plan authorises the repurchase of 206 million shares through the year 2006. There are 44 million shares remaining in the existing repurchase plan, Coca-Cola said.
Together, a total of 250 million shares are authorised for repurchase over the next 10 years, representing 10 percent of outstanding shares, the soft drink giant said.
Coca-Cola's stock rose 87.5 cents to $49.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
